name: runner-never-rewrites-remotes
description: ADR 0260: the runner host fetches into the owner's own checkout, so it must never change that checkout's remotes or write a job token into git config. Fetch and push go by explicit URL with the token in one git process's environment.
message: Don't rewrite a checkout's remotes or embed a token in a URL. Fetch or push by explicit URL with the token served by the command-line credential helper (local/runner-host/src/git.ts). See ADR 0260.
